effect: The meta side-turret: hitscan, huge sustained DPS, no projectile travel time to account for.
effects: House: Zetki — highest damage, builds heat (heat buildup can overheat; Vidar/Lavan run cooler)
Best variant: Zetki Apoc Mk III
Hitscan — point and delete fighters and crewship turrets
Pairs with Gunnery intrinsics and an elite gunner crew
farm: Veil Proxima missions (wreckage drops); repair in the Dry Dock with Dirac and resources.
name: Zetki Apoc
tags: zetki apoc turret weapon hitscan dps best meta side gun
tips: The default 'best' turret most Railjack guides recommend — start here.
Zetki weapons build heat as they fire — manage it with heat-sink Plexus mods or short bursts.
Mk III only; lower marks are mastery fodder.

effect: Rapid-fire projectile turret — top-tier DPS with a satisfying shred.
effects: House: Zetki recommended (max damage); Vidar for crit builds
Best variant: Zetki Laith Mk III
Projectile — lead fast fighters slightly at range
Excellent on the pilot's guns and side turrets alike
farm: Veil Proxima missions (wreckage drops); repair in the Dry Dock.
name: Zetki Laith
tags: zetki laith turret weapon projectile dps meta
tips: Nearly tied with the Apoc for DPS — pick whichever Mk III you get first.
Vidar Laith works if you're building around crit avionics.

effect: Continuous beam turret — melts through heat procs and strips crewship defenses.
effects: House: Zetki recommended
Best variant: Zetki Photor Mk III
Beam — hold on target, applies Heat status constantly
Great vs Corpus crewships and Ramsled-heavy missions
farm: Veil Proxima missions (wreckage drops); repair in the Dry Dock.
name: Zetki Photor
tags: zetki photor beam heat turret weapon status
tips: The status/heat option when raw DPS turrets feel flat.
Beam weapons trivialize boarding Ramsleds before they latch.

effect: The crewship deleter — front artillery with massive crit damage.
effects: House: Vidar — crit-focused, best for artillery one-shots
Best variant: Vidar Cryophon Mk III
Front artillery slot: charge a shot, aim at the crewship's engines/reactor
One-shots most crewships once their shields are down
farm: Veil Proxima missions (wreckage drops); repair in the Dry Dock.
name: Vidar Cryophon
tags: vidar cryophon artillery front ordnance crewship crit
tips: Artillery workflow: pilot holds position, gunner drops crewship shields with turrets, artillery finishes it.
Prioritize the Cryophon over turrets if you can only farm one weapon first.

effect: Your main anti-crewship finisher before you get the Cryophon.
effects: Charged ordnance — hold to charge, release a heavy shell
Aimed from the artillery seat behind the cockpit
Breaks crewships after their shields are stripped
Upgraded by Gunnery intrinsics
farm: Default equipment on every Railjack — no farm needed.
name: Forward Artillery
tags: forward artillery ordnance default crewship charge shot
tips: Aim for the glowing weak points on crewships for bonus damage.
Replace its role with the Vidar Cryophon once you have one.

effect: Three manufacturers, three philosophies — pick by role.
effects: Zetki: +damage, builds heat — best for turrets (Apoc, Laith, Photor)
Vidar: +critical chance/damage — best for artillery (Cryophon)
Lavan: +status chance — best for engines (fastest) and status builds
Always chase Mk III — Mk I/II are stepping stones
Best all-round ship: Zetki turrets + Vidar artillery + Lavan engines
farm: Wreckage drops from Veil Proxima missions; scrap or repair at the Dry Dock.
name: Railjack Houses: Zetki / Vidar / Lavan
tags: houses zetki vidar lavan manufacturer mk III wreckage
tips: Scrap unwanted wreckage for Dirac — don't let the inventory cap block new drops.
A full Mk III Zetki/Vidar/Lavan loadout is the endgame goal.

effect: The single best battle avionics in the game — groups and holds entire fighter wings.
effects: Deploys a singularity that pulls fighters together
Combo: Void Hole + any AoE (turrets, Seeker Volley, Shatter Burst) = cleared wings
Flux cost is high — pair with a Vidar reactor
Unlocked via the Tactical intrinsic tree rewards / Plexus
farm: Railjack missions and Dry Dock research; higher tiers from Veil Proxima.
name: Void Hole
tags: void hole battle avionics best singularity group fighters flux
tips: The 'press 1 to win dogfights' button — the biggest power spike in Railjack.
Pair with Particle Ram for ramming grouped enemies.

effect: Turn your Railjack into a battering ram — ramming damage while boosting.
effects: Damages enemies you collide with while active
Stacks beautifully with Void Hole groupings
Boost (sprint) through fighter packs for free kills
Flux-cheap for what it does
farm: Railjack missions and Dry Dock research.
name: Particle Ram
tags: particle ram battle avionics ramming boost collision
tips: Piloting intrinsic ranks increase ram damage — they synergize directly.
Best used by the pilot weaving through grouped fighters.

effect: Homing missile swarm — fire and forget fighter clearance.
effects: Launches a volley of homing missiles
Great for the pilot or a gunner to clear stragglers
Lower flux cost than Void Hole — spammable
Synergizes with target-painting intrinsics
farm: Railjack missions and Dry Dock research.
name: Seeker Volley
tags: seeker volley battle avionics missiles homing
tips: The lazy option: fire it at a fighter wing and go back to piloting.
Less total clear than Void Hole combos, but zero aiming required.

effect: The Plexus mods that actually matter — damage, survivability and utility.
effects: Hyperstrike: +turret damage — the Serration of Railjack
Ironclad Matrix / Hull Weave: armor and hull — stop getting one-shot in Veil
Predator / other crit mods: pair with Vidar weapons
Conic Nozzle / Cruising Speed: engine speed for objective rushing
Fire Suppression (Tactical): auto-repairs hull breaches
Reactor: Vidar (most avionics capacity + flux energy)
Shield Array: Zetki (biggest shields)
Engines: Lavan (fastest) or Vidar
farm: Wreckage and mission rewards across Saturn, Neptune and Veil Proximas; Dirac from scrapping wreckage.
name: Key Plexus Mods & Components
tags: plexus mods avionics hyperstrike ironclad hull weave reactor vidar zetki lavan dirac
tips: Hyperstrike + Ironclad Matrix + a Vidar reactor is the core of every good build.
Polarize Plexus slots — Railjack mod drain gets expensive fast.
Scrap everything below Mk III for Dirac.

effect: Elite crew from Ticker turn a solo Railjack into a crewed warship.
effects: Hire from Ticker in Fortuna (Orb Vallis) — contracts cost credits
Look for Elite Crewmen with 5 pips in a stat — they're rare, check back often
2x Gunners (Gunnery 5): they man turrets with real accuracy
1x Engineer (Engineering 5): auto-repairs hull breaches and fires
Do NOT assign a Pilot — AI pilots are terrible; fly it yourself
Defenders are low value — boarders are rare and you can handle them
farm: Ticker, Fortuna (Orb Vallis). Refresh his crew contracts regularly for 5-pip elites.
name: Elite Crew — Gunners & Engineers
tags: crew ticker fortuna elite gunner engineer pilot defender contract
tips: Command intrinsics unlock extra crew slots — level it for a full crew.
Gunnery 5 gunners with Zetki turrets genuinely carry missions.
Engineers with high Combat also fight boarders; Repair duty keeps the ship alive solo.

effect: Five skill trees that define what your Railjack can do — level them all eventually.
effects: Tactical (10): recall warps, fast-travel, and the Archwing slingshot upgrades
Piloting (10): boost, drift, ramming damage, and the all-important +speed
Gunnery (10): turret damage/crit, ordnance unlocks, artillery efficiency
Engineering (10): forge, repair speed, and automatic breach sealing
Command (10): crew slots, elite crew contracts, and converting Liches/Sisters into crew
Each rank costs Intrinsic points earned from Railjack missions and objectives
farm: Gian Point, Veil Proxima (exterminate) — dense fighters, quick clears. Best intrinsics-per-minute in the game.
name: Intrinsics — How They Work
tags: intrinsics tactical piloting gunnery engineering command farm gian point ranks
tips: Priority order for new captains: Gunnery → Engineering → Piloting → Tactical → Command.
Gunnery 5 unlocks the good ordnance; Engineering 5+ makes hull breaches a non-issue.
Gian Point runs with a booster can max a tree shockingly fast.

effect: The Railjack endgame zone — highest-level missions, best wreckage.
effects: Gian Point (Skirmish/Exterminate): the classic farm — intrinsics, Dirac, Mk III wreckage
Veil Proxima is the highest tier (level 80–100 enemies)
Farm here for: Mk III Zetki/Vidar/Lavan wreckage, Plexus mods, intrinsics
Bring a finished Railjack — Veil punishes underbuilt ships
farm: Pluto Proxima junction → Veil Proxima. Unlock via the Rising Tide quest + Railjack construction.
name: Veil Proxima — Endgame Farming
tags: veil proxima gian point farm mk III wreckage intrinsics dirac endgame
tips: Gian Point is THE farm: quick exterminate, dense spawns, great returns.
Scrap wreckage between runs — the inventory cap fills fast.
Veil crewships need artillery; don't queue Veil without a Cryophon or charged Forward Artillery.

effect: Unlock the Railjack itself — the Rising Tide quest chain.
effects: Quest: Rising Tide (after Second Dream) — rebuild your Railjack from a derelict
Build in your Clan Dojo Dry Dock (or buy with platinum to skip)
Key resources: lots of credits, salvage, and patience — it's a long quest
Tip: the platinum skip exists if you just want to fly
farm: Quest: Rising Tide. Dry Dock: Clan Dojo (or Relay Dry Docks).
name: Getting Your Railjack
tags: rising tide quest dry dock unlock railjack build guide
tips: Join a clan with a built Dry Dock — you can't start without one.
The quest is long but story-rich; don't rush it.
Buy a crew contract from Ticker as soon as you can fly — solo Railjack is rough.

effect: The artillery mech — Arquebex barrages delete everything, including Orphix.
effects: Abilities: Necraweb (mine), Storm Shroud (damage shield), Guard Mode, Arquebex (artillery barrage)
Arquebex: deploys cannons, massive radial damage — the reason Voidrig is meta
Highest burst DPS of any Necramech; squishier than Bonewidow
Meta pick for: Orphix missions, Profit-Taker-style fights, general Deimos/Cambion Drift work
farm: Damaged Necramech parts from Isolation Vaults (Deimos); main blueprint from Loid (Necraloid syndicate).
name: Voidrig
tags: voidrig necramech arquebex artillery orphix best dps deimos
tips: Arquebex is the single highest burst damage tool Necramechs have — build around it.
Storm Shroud is your panic button when the barrage draws aggro.
Voidrig is the recommended first mech for almost everyone.

effect: The tank mech — Ironbride exalted sword and a literal riot shield.
effects: Abilities: Meathook (grab + slam), Shield Maiden (directional shield), Firing Line (dash), Ironbride (exalted greatsword)
Tankier than Voidrig with strong melee via Ironbride
Shield Maiden blocks frontal damage — great for holding positions
Slower clear speed than Voidrig's Arquebex, but nearly unkillable when built right
farm: Damaged parts from Tier-3 Isolation Vault bounties (Deimos); blueprint from Loid at higher Necraloid rank.
name: Bonewidow
tags: bonewidow necramech ironbride tank melee shield maiden deimos
tips: Pick Bonewidow if you love melee and want to face-tank Steel Path Deimos.
Ironbride builds scale absurdly with Necramech Pressure Point + Fury.
Meathook + Ironbride slam is one of the most satisfying combos in the game.

effect: Which mech to build first — the honest breakdown.
effects: Damage: Voidrig wins — Arquebex burst is unmatched
Survivability: Bonewidow wins — more armor/HP and Shield Maiden
Ease of use: Voidrig — point Arquebex, delete room
Fun factor: Bonewidow — Ironbride greatsword gameplay
Verdict: build Voidrig first (Orphix + general use), Bonewidow second for fun
Both share the same core mods — gearing the second is cheap
farm: Both from Deimos: Isolation Vaults (Voidrig) and Tier-3 vault bounties (Bonewidow).
name: Voidrig vs Bonewidow
tags: voidrig bonewidow comparison which better vs tank dps
tips: If you only build one: Voidrig. Arquebex trivializes Orphix and open-world bosses.
Mods transfer between mechs — Rage, Repair, Steel work on both.
Level both to 40 for mastery — mechs give affinity like warframes.

effect: How to actually get a mech: vaults, bounties and Necraloid standing.
effects: Step 1: Run Isolation Vaults on Deimos (Cambion Drift) — damaged parts drop: Weapon Pod, Engine, Pod, Casing
Step 2: Rank up the Necraloid syndicate (Loid, in the Necralisk) for the main blueprints
Step 3: Build each part in the Foundry (12h each) then the mech (72h)
Voidrig parts: Isolation Vaults tiers 1–3
Bonewidow parts: Tier-3 Isolation Vault bounties
Tip: vaults are easier in a squad; bring a tanky frame and strong weapons
farm: Cambion Drift, Deimos — Isolation Vaults (Mother in the Necralisk). Necraloid standing from vault runs and Matrix turn-ins.
name: Getting a Necramech
tags: get necramech isolation vaults deimos necraloid loid damaged parts blueprint guide
tips: Isolation Vaults also drop Necramech mods — farm parts and mods together.
Save Father tokens and Matrixes — Necraloid standing is the real gate.
You need a built Necramech (or a friend's) for The New War — don't skip this.

effect: The core mod set every Necramech wants — farm these in Deimos vaults.
effects: Necramech Rage: +damage on Energy Orb pickup — the best damage mod, period
Necramech Repair: +health on Energy Orb pickup — your sustain
Necramech Steel: +armor — stack with the mech's already-high armor
Necramech Rebuke: +damage when damaged — pairs with Rage for huge multipliers
Necramech Continuity: +ability duration
Necramech Flow: +energy pool
Necramech Drift: +sprint speed
Necramech Thrusters: +hover speed
Necramech Vitality / Redirection: +health / +shields
farm: Isolation Vaults (Deimos) — mod drops from vault enemies and bounties. Some from Necraloid offerings.
name: Essential Necramech Mods
tags: necramech mods rage repair steel rebuke continuity flow drift thrusters farm
tips: Rage + Repair is the engine: drop orbs, pick them up, get damage AND healing.
Rage/Repair/Rebuke/Steel is the core 4 — everything else is preference.
Energy orbs are plentiful in vaults; in open worlds bring a synth or orb source.

effect: Melee mods for the Bonewidow's Ironbride exalted sword.
effects: Necramech Pressure Point: +melee damage — mandatory
Necramech Fury: +attack speed
Necramech Reach: +range
Necramech Steel / Rage / Repair: the defensive core still applies
Crit mods if your Ironbride build leans crit (Blood Rush-style setups)
farm: Isolation Vaults and Tier-3 bounties on Deimos.
name: Ironbride Melee Mods
tags: ironbride melee mods pressure point fury reach bonewidow exalted
tips: Pressure Point + Fury + Reach is the Ironbride starter kit.
Ironbride benefits from combo — keep it spinning in long fights.

effect: The meta Orphix/Eidolon-adjacent artillery build — maximum Arquebex damage.
effects: Necramech Rage — damage on energy orb pickup
Necramech Repair — sustain on energy orb pickup
Necramech Intensify — ability strength for Arquebex scaling
Necramech Continuity — longer Storm Shroud / buff uptime
Necramech Steel — armor buffer
Necramech Rebuke — damage when hit
Necramech Flow — energy for repeated barrages
Flex: Necramech Drift for mobility between barrages
Rotation: Storm Shroud → deploy → Arquebex barrage → reposition
farm: Mods from Isolation Vaults; mech from Deimos vaults + Necraloid.
name: Voidrig Arquebex Build — Orphix
tags: voidrig arquebex build orphix eidolon intensify rage artillery
tips: Arquebex shreds Orphix Resonators — this build is the Orphix Venom meta.
Drop energy orbs before the barrage (or use Synth) to preload Rage stacks.
In Orphix missions, position with line-of-sight to the Orphix — Arquebex needs it.

effect: The Bonewidow blender — Ironbride greatsword with full support.
effects: Necramech Pressure Point — melee damage
Necramech Fury — attack speed
Necramech Reach — range
Necramech Rage — damage on energy orb
Necramech Repair — sustain
Necramech Steel — armor
Flex: Rebuke / Continuity
Rotation: Meathook a heavy → Ironbride combo → Shield Maiden to reposition
farm: Mods from Deimos vaults/bounties; Bonewidow from Tier-3 vault bounties.
name: Ironbride Build — Bonewidow
tags: ironbride build bonewidow melee pressure point fury
tips: Meathook groups enemies for Ironbride slams — the core loop.
Shield Maiden lets you hold a doorway against Steel Path spawns.
Slightly slower than Arquebex builds, but far tankier and more fun in melee range.

effect: Where mechs shine: Orphix, open worlds and New War content.
effects: Orphix missions (Railjack): Voidrig Arquebex is the meta Resonator killer
The New War quest: a built Necramech is REQUIRED
Cambion Drift: mechs trivialize vaults and assassination bounties
Profit-Taker / Orb Vallis: Arquebex chunks spider legs
Eidolon hunts: mechs see niche use; Arquebex contributes but isn't the meta
Level mechs to 40 — they grant mastery like warframes and weapons
farm: Orphix: Railjack missions (Veil Proxima). Necramech required content: The New War.
name: Where Necramechs Matter
tags: orphix new war eidolon profit-taker where use necramech
tips: Build your Voidrig BEFORE starting The New War — the quest soft-requires it.
Orphix Venom event returns periodically; Arquebex builds print rewards there.
Mechs can't use Archguns in mech form — your mech weapons are your weapons.
